title: Verification Report
description:
The evidence behind a QA verdict: every technical-readiness check run against one commit of a game repository, its status, and what was run or seen to reach it.

The qa-report is the summary a gate reads; this is what it was computed from. Each check is PASS, FAIL, BLOCKED or WARNING, and since 1.1.0 also carries an evidence status (PASS, PASS_MOCK, BLOCKED_EXTERNAL, UNVERIFIED, FAIL) saying how strong the evidence behind it is. BLOCKED is a statement about the verification, not the game: the check could not be established (no checkout, a missing tool, a failed prerequisite). A check without evidence is an assertion, and is refused.

Platform readiness is local and deterministic. It never states that a portal approved or will approve the build — `external_approval` is always `not-claimed`.

commit.description: The commit under test. `sha` is null only when no checkout could be read, which blocks the verdict.

dirty.description: Uncommitted changes in the checkout: the build is then not reproducible from `sha`.

repository.description: Where the checkout was, for diagnostics.

build_artifact.description: The bundle the checks ran against, pinned by a digest over its paths and contents.

gameplay_driver.description: What drove the game in a browser: a recorded interactive session (playwright-mcp), the repository's own browser suites (repository-playwright), or nothing.

platform_readiness.description: Per target platform in game.config.yaml. ready: every check about it, and every required shared check, passed. unverified: nothing failed but something could not be established.

external_approval.description: Portal approval is an external, later event. A verification that claimed it would be claiming something it cannot observe.

evidence_status.description: Since 1.1.0. The weakest evidence status among this platform's checks and the required shared ones.

verdict.description: Derived, not asserted: FAIL if any required check failed; else BLOCKED if any required check is blocked; else PASS. Warnings never change it.

evidence_status.description: Since 1.1.0. The weakest evidence status among the required checks: what the verdict rests on. A PASS verdict whose required checks include PASS_MOCK evidence is PASS_MOCK here, and stays so downstream.

required.description: Whether this check can block the verdict. A non-required check reports FAIL as WARNING.

evidence_status.description: Since 1.1.0. Defaults from status (PASS->PASS, FAIL->FAIL, BLOCKED/WARNING->UNVERIFIED) and may only be weaker: a PASS observed against a stand-in is PASS_MOCK.

output_tail.description: The end of the command's output: enough to see a failure, not the whole log.
